summary: Verified the Pending Approvals 'Requester Details' feature end-to-end on /pending-approvals as admin@finance.app. Backend GET /api/approvals/pending returns 200 with 219 items, ALL populated with a `requester` object (name, employee_code, department, designation). 185/219 items have a populated employee_code; the remaining 34 gracefully show N/A. The target regularisation (request_id 4d4e2aeb-ff8c-40ee-8f0c-bfbdde3e3327) renders exactly as expected: Requester TEST_L1Mgr_e0e668, Employee ID EMP-2026-0182, Designation Manager, Department N/A. All 219 cards render the `requester-details-<request_id>` box (multiple types: advance, payment, regularisation, transfer, reimbursement, leave, quotation, etc.). Missing fields fall back to 'N/A' without breaking layout. Reject regression completed: opened Reject dialog on a TEST_* advance card, filled remarks, clicked Confirm Reject — the card disappeared and total dropped 219→218 (call to /api/approvals/act succeeded). Approve dialog opens correctly with the requester summary embedded and a Confirm Approve button (min 3-char remark is enforced client-side, which is expected). Send Back button is present for applicable types. Mobile 390px viewport wraps the requester details chips cleanly. No console errors on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: PendingApprovals.jsx has grown large; consider extracting the card body (requester box, purpose, vendor, description, action buttons) into a `<PendingApprovalCard>` subcomponent for maintainability.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on other pages (Dashboard) — set a minWidth/minHeight or explicit container size on the ResponsiveContainer parents (not blocking, but noisy in console).
seed_data_creation: None. Only mutated 1 TEST_* record (rejected TEST_AttachStaff_a7a7d3 advance request 4071a8df-8d30-4ecc-9cc9-bafc0cabc93f) as regression proof; approve was opened but not submitted (avoided mass-mutation of ~219 real records).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified working: PendingApprovals shows 'Requester Details' box on every card with real backend data. 218 pending approvals remain (was 219; one TEST_ advance rejected during regression). Approve/Reject dialogs work; both require min-3-char remarks. Send Back is available for payment/quotation types.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only. Backend list_pending_approvals batch-enriches every item with `requester` object (from db.staff by staff_id or user_id, fallback db.users). Frontend renders inside a dedicated 'Requester Details' block with N/A fallbacks and data-testid=requester-details-<request_id>.
